records.name: AA-3D: Interactive 3D Experience Benchmark
records.unit: Elo (Bradley-Terry, GPT-6 Luna Max anchored at 1000)
records.citationNote: [M] Human preference, blind pairwise votes of a recruited panel; each scene viewed >= 30 s and interactable. 55 three.js briefs, Stirrup harness, offline sandbox, 3 h / 250 turns, 1 attempt. Scenes that fail a headless run check or manual review are excluded BEFORE voting, so the Elo is preference among valid scenes only; AA publishes no excluded share. Creative-class evidence only; never coding routing quality.

records.name: Arena Code Arena: WebDev (WebDev Arena)
records.citationNote: [M] Human preference: users submit their own request, two anonymous models build it, the user votes A, B, tie or both bad. No pre-vote exclusion of broken builds is documented; 'both bad' is a vote. No cost per task is published. Retrieved from Arena's own Hugging Face leaderboard dataset because the web leaderboard blocks automated clients. UI/web and creative evidence only.

records.name: Arena 3D leaderboard (Code Arena battles requesting a 3D result)
records.citationNote: [M] Same human-vote method as Code Arena, restricted to battles an LLM classifier labels as explicitly requesting 3D (about 96% agreement with a manual check). Launch snapshot values published in the 24 Nov 2026 post's chart data. Ties 8%, both bad 13% of 3D battles; no pre-vote exclusion; no cost per task.

records.name: Design Arena: 3D Design (HTML, non-agentic)
records.citationNote: [M] Blind head-to-head user votes on single-shot HTML 3D scenes. Effort is the provider default unless the model id names one; the default is not published. No broken-build exclusion rule published. Average cost per generation published.

records.name: Design Arena: Game Dev (HTML, non-agentic)
records.citationNote: [M] Blind head-to-head user votes on single-shot playable browser games. Effort is the provider default unless named. No broken-build exclusion rule published. Average cost per generation published.

records.name: Design Arena: Agentic Game Dev (Three.js)
records.citationNote: [M] Blind head-to-head user votes on multi-file Three.js games built end to end by coding agents. Effort is named in the model id. No interval published on this board. Average cost per build published.
